description.value: Circle K is a 24/7 convenience store and petrol station on East Broadway in Vancouver, part of the international Circle K/Couche-Tard chain. Touring cyclists can pick up snacks, beverages, and hot food from the Roller Grill at any hour. Its around-the-clock operation makes it a reliable resupply point on this busy commercial corridor.
